items.title: UNM Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Premium Growth and Investment Income
items.summary: Unum Group's Q3 2026 earnings beat estimates despite a 21.7% decline, as premium growth and Colonial Life's strength offset elevated disability claims.

items.title: CNA Q3 Earnings Miss on Higher LTC Reserves, Catastrophe Losses
items.summary: CNA Financial's Q3 earnings fall 50% as reserve updates and catastrophe losses pressure underwriting, despite premium growth and improved International results.

items.title: SIGI Outperforms Industry, Trades at a Premium: Time to Hold or Buy?
items.summary: Selective Insurance's improving underwriting margins, higher investment income and strong ROE support growth, but catastrophe losses and rising costs pose risks.

items.title: WTW Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Margin Gains, Revenues Miss
items.summary: Willis Towers Watson beats Q3 earnings estimates as organic growth, expanding margins and strong cash flow support its 2026 outlook and AI-driven savings plan.

items.title: Arch Capital Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Higher Investment Income
items.summary: ACGL's Q3 2026 earnings beat estimates on higher investment income, but lower premiums, rising catastrophe losses and weaker underwriting weighed on results.

items.title: Aon Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Organic Growth, Margin Expansion
items.summary: Aon beat Q3 earnings estimates with 6% organic revenue growth and a 70-basis-point margin gain, reaffirming its 2026 outlook ahead of the planned USI deal.

items.title: PFG Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates on Lower Investment Income
items.summary: Principal Financial's Q3 earnings missed estimates despite higher revenues, as lower investment income, rising expenses and net cash outflows weighed on results.

items.title: CINF Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Premium Growth, Investment Income
items.summary: Cincinnati Financial's Q3 earnings beat estimates by 43.7%, fueled by premium growth and investment income, despite higher catastrophe losses and expenses.
